HOW GRANDISON CAN HELP

From a repair to a new room.

Describe the bathroom project first

For a bathroom installation or renovation enquiry, include photographs, room dimensions and whether you are keeping the layout. Say if the property has another bathroom and whether products have been ordered. Coverage, the scope of trades and timing must be agreed before you plan around an installation.

  • Bathroom renovation scope →
  • Prepare a bathroom brief →

Explain the plumbing or heating requirements

For plumbing repairs, describe the affected fitting and symptoms. For radiator installation or central heating work, include the current layout and planned changes. Share any access or parking restrictions when checking whether the work can be taken on.

  • Plumbing enquiries →
  • Radiators & towel rails →
  • Central heating →

Check boiler appointment availability directly

Boiler installation, servicing and repairs involve different visits. Explain the appliance details and whether it is working when asking about Edinburgh availability. Do not assume an immediate call-out or a confirmed booking from the service information on this website.

BEFORE YOU ENQUIRE

Check the practical details first

Share your full postcode, the type of property and the size of the job. Access, parking arrangements and the timing of other trades can matter for a larger installation. For a bathroom, include room photos and whether you want a complete renovation or a more limited replacement.

  • Confirm coverage before ordering around an installation date.
  • Describe any access or parking restrictions.
  • Include preferred timing and whether it is flexible.

GOOD TO KNOW

Your questions,
answered.

Is Edinburgh a confirmed routine service area?

Fife is the main service area. Edinburgh work is subject to confirmation of coverage and availability for the particular job. Contact Connor before making arrangements.

Can I arrange an urgent Edinburgh call-out through this page?

No appointment or response time is promised by this page. Contact Connor directly to check availability; an around-the-clock emergency service is not advertised.

What should I send when asking about an Edinburgh project?

Send the postcode, a description of the work, relevant photographs, access details and preferred timing. Explain whether dates are flexible and whether other trades are already booked.
